[![An Ending soundtrack.png](/images/thumb/An_Ending_soundtrack.png/300px-An_Ending_soundtrack.png.webp?cb=2wypr5&h=thumb.php&f=An_Ending_soundtrack.png)](https://undertale.wiki/w/File:An_Ending_soundtrack.png)

Sans's dialogue at the end of a [Neutral Route](https://undertale.wiki/w/Neutral_Route "Neutral Route")

There are three main **endings** in _[Undertale](https://undertale.wiki/w/Undertale "Undertale")_ — the [Neutral Route](https://undertale.wiki/w/Neutral_Route "Neutral Route"), the [True Pacifist Route](https://undertale.wiki/w/True_Pacifist_Route "True Pacifist Route"), and the [Genocide Route](https://undertale.wiki/w/Genocide_Route "Genocide Route") — as well as [Hard Mode](https://undertale.wiki/w/Hard_Mode "Hard Mode"), an unfinished fourth ending.

This ending occurs when one of these conditions are met:

*   [The protagonist](https://undertale.wiki/w/Frisk "Frisk") does not befriend all plot pivotal characters ([Papyrus](https://undertale.wiki/w/Papyrus "Papyrus"), [Undyne](https://undertale.wiki/w/Undyne "Undyne"), [Alphys](https://undertale.wiki/w/Alphys "Alphys")).
*   The [True Lab](https://undertale.wiki/w/True_Lab "True Lab") has not been explored.
*   The protagonist kills any, but not every, [monster](https://undertale.wiki/w/Monster "Monster").

In the Neutral Route ending, the protagonist escapes the [underground](https://undertale.wiki/w/Underground "Underground") alone, and [Sans](https://undertale.wiki/w/Sans "Sans") calls them on the [phone](https://undertale.wiki/w/Cell_Phone "Cell Phone") to report how the underground is doing. Depending on the protagonist's choices, many different variations of this ending are possible, mostly differing in the dialogue Sans says.

This ending occurs when all of these conditions are met:

*   A Neutral Route has been completed. (A reset is not required, only reloading the [player](https://undertale.wiki/w/Player "Player")'s [SAVE file](https://undertale.wiki/w/SAVE_file "SAVE file") afterwards.)
*   No monsters were killed throughout the game. (The protagonist cannot gain any [EXP](https://undertale.wiki/w/EXP "EXP"), and as a result, they cannot progress past [LV](https://undertale.wiki/w/LOVE "LOVE") 1.)
*   Papyrus, Undyne, and Alphys have been befriended.
*   The True Lab has been explored.

The True Pacifist Route ends with the [barrier](https://undertale.wiki/w/Barrier "Barrier") being broken, and the protagonist and the monsters of the underground being able to leave. Additionally, this route features the [True Pacifist ending credits](https://undertale.wiki/w/True_Pacifist_ending_credits "True Pacifist ending credits").

This ending occurs only when all enemies in each area ([Ruins](https://undertale.wiki/w/Ruins "Ruins"), [Snowdin](https://undertale.wiki/w/Snowdin "Snowdin"), [Waterfall](https://undertale.wiki/w/Waterfall "Waterfall"), [Hotland](https://undertale.wiki/w/Hotland "Hotland")/[CORE](https://undertale.wiki/w/CORE "CORE")) are killed until no one remains. This includes all [bosses](https://undertale.wiki/w/Boss "Boss").

Completing the Genocide Route leads to the destruction of the game's world. Upon re-launching the game after a completed Genocide Route, the [fallen human](https://undertale.wiki/w/Chara "Chara") asks the protagonist to give up their [SOUL](https://undertale.wiki/w/SOUL "SOUL") to them in exchange for the recreation of the world. This effectively acts in the same way as a [True Reset](https://undertale.wiki/w/True_Reset "True Reset") from the True Pacifist Route, but it also permanently alters the endings of any later Genocide or True Pacifist endings. Neutral endings after a Genocide Route are unaffected.

This mode is activated when naming the fallen human "Frisk". It results in [more difficult battles](https://undertale.wiki/w/Category:Hard_Mode_Enemies "Category:Hard Mode Enemies") in the Ruins, some exclusive to this mode, and some usually found in the CORE. Some slight dialogue and item changes are also present. Similarly to the [_Undertale_ Demo](https://undertale.wiki/w/Undertale_Demo "Undertale Demo"), this mode only lasts until the end of the Ruins, where the [Annoying Dog](https://undertale.wiki/w/Annoying_Dog "Annoying Dog") arrives to announce the end of Hard Mode.

The **Genocide Route** leads to one of the three main [endings](https://undertale.wiki/w/Endings "Endings") of _[Undertale](https://undertale.wiki/w/Undertale "Undertale")_. It consists of [the protagonist](https://undertale.wiki/w/Frisk "Frisk") actively killing [monsters](https://undertale.wiki/w/Monster "Monster"), mandatory [minibosses](https://undertale.wiki/w/Miniboss "Miniboss"), and [bosses](https://undertale.wiki/w/Boss "Boss") in the [underground](https://undertale.wiki/w/Underground "Underground") regions.

This route's ending can occur without prior completion of the game, unlike the [True Pacifist Route](https://undertale.wiki/w/True_Pacifist_Route "True Pacifist Route"). Upon completion, subsequent True Pacifist Route and Genocide Route endings are [altered with new dialogue and cutscenes](#Post-Genocide_game), even after a [True Reset](https://undertale.wiki/w/True_Reset "True Reset").

On [console versions](https://undertale.wiki/w/Version_differences "Version differences") of the game, the post-Genocide changes only affect the [player](https://undertale.wiki/w/Player "Player") profile used for finishing the route.

[![But Nobody Came screenshot.png](/images/thumb/But_Nobody_Came_screenshot.png/400px-But_Nobody_Came_screenshot.png.webp?cb=kl5b25&h=thumb.php&f=But_Nobody_Came_screenshot.png)](https://undertale.wiki/w/File:But_Nobody_Came_screenshot.png)

Battle text after the protagonist exhausts the kill count

Starting in the [Ruins](https://undertale.wiki/w/Ruins "Ruins"), the protagonist must repeatedly trigger the random [encounters](https://undertale.wiki/w/Encounter "Encounter") by walking in areas where encounters can occur.
